UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a non-vendor user (e.g., a couple) interacting with the InFaith Journey platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for communication and login.

fullName.description: The full name of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp indicating the user's last login time.

VendorProfile.title: VendorProfile
VendorProfile.description: Represents a wedding vendor's listing and detailed profile information on the marketplace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the VendorProfile entity.

businessName.description: The registered name of the vendor's business.

category.description: The primary service category of the vendor (e.g., 'Venue', 'Photographer', 'Caterer').

location.description: The primary operational location of the vendor (e.g., 'Cape Town', 'Johannesburg').

shortDescription.description: A brief summary of the vendor's services or business.

aboutDescription.description: A detailed 'About Us' section text for the vendor's profile page.

minPrice.description: The minimum estimated price for the vendor's services or packages in ZAR.

maxPrice.description: The maximum estimated price for the vendor's services or packages in ZAR.

membershipPlan.description: The current membership plan of the vendor (e.g., 'FREE', 'STANDARD', 'FEATURED').

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the vendor's main profile image or logo.

galleryImageUrls.description: An array of URLs to images in the vendor's portfolio gallery.

servicesOffered.description: A list of specific services or packages offered by the vendor.

contactEmail.description: The primary email address for contacting the vendor.

contactPhone.description: The primary phone number for contacting the vendor.

facebookUrl.description: URL to the vendor's Facebook profile or page.

instagramUrl.description: URL to the vendor's Instagram profile.

websiteUrl.description: URL to the vendor's official website.

averageRating.description: The calculated average rating (0.0 to 5.0) from reviews for this vendor.

reviewCount.description: The total number of reviews submitted for this vendor.

isApproved.description: Indicates if the vendor's profile has been approved by an administrator and is live on the marketplace.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the vendor profile was initially created/submitted.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the vendor profile was updated.

SavedVendor.title: SavedVendor
SavedVendor.description: A denormalized reference to a vendor saved by a user in their wishlist.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Manages a vendor's membership subscription details and payment status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Subscription entity.

planType.description: The type of membership plan subscribed to (e.g., 'FREE', 'STANDARD', 'FEATURED').

status.description: The current status of the subscription (e.g., 'active', 'cancelled', 'expired', 'pending').

startDate.description: The date when the subscription became active.

endDate.description: The date when the subscription is set to expire or was cancelled. Null for 'FREE' plans.

paymentGatewaySubscriptionId.description: The unique identifier for this subscription within the payment gateway (e.g., PayFast, Stripe).

amount.description: The recurring amount billed for this subscription in ZAR.

currency.description: The currency of the subscription amount (e.g., 'ZAR').

billingCycle.description: The billing frequency for the subscription (e.g., 'monthly', 'annually', 'free').

lastPaymentDate.description: The date of the most recent successful payment.

nextPaymentDate.description: The scheduled date for the next payment.

Inquiry.title: Inquiry
Inquiry.description: Stores details of a request for a quote or general inquiry sent from a user to a vendor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Inquiry entity.

vendorId.description: Reference to VendorProfile, the recipient of the inquiry. (Relationship: VendorProfile 1:N Inquiry)

userId.description: Reference to UserProfile, the sender of the inquiry. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Inquiry)

message.description: The detailed message or request from the user.

contactName.description: The name of the user making the inquiry.

contactEmail.description: The email address of the user for replies.

contactPhone.description: The phone number of the user for direct contact.

eventDate.description: The proposed date of the event, if specified by the user.

guestCount.description: The estimated number of guests for the event, if specified.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the inquiry was submitted.

status.description: The current status of the inquiry (e.g., 'new', 'read', 'responded', 'archived').

source.description: The source or channel through which the inquiry was initiated (e.g., 'direct', 'ai_recommendation', 'homepage_form').

AIChatSession.title: AIChatSession
AIChatSession.description: Represents a single conversation session between a user and the AI Wedding Venue Assistant.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AIChatSession entity.

userId.description: Reference to UserProfile, the user participating in this chat session. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N AIChatSession)

startTime.description: Timestamp indicating when the chat session began.

lastActivityTime.description: Timestamp of the most recent message exchanged within this session.

initialPrompt.description: The very first query or topic presented by the user at the start of the session.

status.description: The current status of the chat session (e.g., 'active', 'closed').

AIChatMessage.title: AIChatMessage
AIChatMessage.description: Represents an individual message (user input or AI response) within an AI chat session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AIChatMessage entity.

sessionId.description: Reference to AIChatSession, the chat session this message belongs to. (Relationship: AIChatSession 1:N AIChatMessage)

senderType.description: Indicates whether the message was sent by the 'user' or the 'ai'.

content.description: The text content of the message.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

recommendedVendorIds.description: An array of VendorProfile IDs that the AI recommended in this specific message. (Relationship: VendorProfile N:N AIChatMessage)

extractedParameters.description: JSON string of key parameters (e.g., budget, location, style, guest count, event date) extracted by the AI from the user's input, used to guide recommendations. This field stores a JSON string representation of an object containing these parameters.
